description:
Import products from a platform other than Shopify/WooCommerce (use import_products_from_url for those): Google Merchant Center feed, BigCommerce, Square, Etsy, Ecwid, Printful, Printify, PrestaShop, Magento, or — for Wix, Squarespace, or any other site — a generic sitemap scan that reads schema.org Product data. For a spreadsheet/CSV export from a platform not listed here, use import_product_spreadsheet instead. Products save as drafts by default for review. Required fields depend on source:
• google-merchant: feedUrl (the public XML or CSV/TSV feed URL the seller already submits to Google — not the Merchant Center dashboard page).
• bigcommerce: storeHash + accessToken (Settings → API Accounts → create an API account with Products read scope; the store hash is in that account's API path).
• square: accessToken (Developer Dashboard → app → Credentials) + optional environment ("production" default, or "sandbox").
• etsy: apiKey (Etsy keystring from etsy.com/developers/your-apps) + shopId or shopName.
• ecwid: storeId (Control Panel → Settings → General → Store Profile) + optional publicToken (most stores need one — Settings → API).
• printful: apiKey (Printful dashboard → Settings → Stores → API) + optional printfulStoreId for multi-store accounts.
• printify: apiToken (My profile → Connections → Generate new token) + shopId (GET /shops.json or the dashboard URL).
• prestashop: shopUrl + wsKey (Advanced Parameters → Webservice → enable it and add a key with GET access on products/categories).
• magento: storeUrl + accessToken (System → Extensions → Integrations → create + activate one with Catalog Product read scope).
• sitemap: siteUrl (any public site). Crawls /sitemap.xml and reads embedded Product structured data — works well for Wix, Squarespace, and custom sites that mark up products for SEO; results are best-effort and should be reviewed before publishing.

feedUrl.description: google-merchant: the public feed URL (XML or CSV/TSV)

importAs.description: Import visibility. Use draft for review workflows; active only when the user clearly wants products published immediately.

maxProducts.description: Maximum products to import. Default 100 (40 for sitemap scans).

printfulStoreId.description: printful: optional store ID for multi-store accounts

replaceDemoProducts.description: Delete template demo/sample products before importing. Default false.

shopId.description: etsy: numeric shop ID (alternative to shopName); printify: shop ID

siteUrl.description: sitemap: the public site URL to crawl

name: import_product_feed
